The holding company owns 49% of Mopani and 20.6% of KCM; recovery now hinges on operating reforms and restarting production at both assets.

title: Zambia fuel prices unchanged for September 2026
summary: The Energy Regulation Board kept national pump prices flat for September 2026: petrol K25.29/litre, diesel K26.86, kerosene K27.02 and Jet A-1 K28.71. Stability persisted despite pressure from international oil prices and the exchange rate, giving households and businesses another month of fuel-cost certainty.

title: Zambia H1 2026 energy investment tops US$1bn; new rules for generators

title: Zambia sets five-year economic focus on investment, production, exports and jobs

title: ZRA suspends customs duty on specified wheat imports for September 2026

title: Airtel, MTN sued for K10 billion over alleged pyramid scheme

title: AfDB Country Focus Report 2026: mobilising Zambia's development financing
summary: The African Development Bank's Country Focus Report 2026 on Zambia notes real GDP rebounded to 5.2% in 2025 (from 3.8% in 2024), driven by agriculture, ICT, manufacturing and mining, with net exports and FDI the main demand-side drivers. Growth is projected around 5.0%, with the report focused on scaling up development financing in a fragmented global environment.
